nonBlockingIssues.description: Extended PS/2 scancodes (arrow keys, navigation keys, right modifiers, numpad enter/divide) use base scancodes instead of QEMU key numbers with 0x80 bit. ~15 keys affected: arrows map to numpad keys, Home/End/Insert/Delete/PageUp/PageDown map to numpad equivalents. Fix: update SCANCODE_MAP values for these keys.
nonBlockingIssues.affectedKeys: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, ControlRight, AltRight, NumpadEnter, NumpadDivide

nonBlockingIssues.description: TypeError over-classification in classifyError(): all TypeErrors classified as 'network' errors. Could mask runtime TypeErrors unrelated to fetch.
Empty catch block in render loop silently swallows all errors. Justified for resilience during Wasm memory resizing, but could mask real bugs.
Silent catch blocks in fullscreen handlers (.catch(() => {})) swallow Fullscreen API errors without any logging.
Console interception only captures messages prefixed with '[QEMU]'. Emscripten stderr/stdout output without this prefix won't appear in the debug panel.
Non-null assertions (!) on all DOM element lookups in main.ts. A typo in element IDs would produce null with no helpful error.
Unused exported formatLogEntry() function is tested but never called at runtime. DebugLogger.log() contains duplicate formatting logic.
No error handling around FS.truncate for the 2GB sparse disk image. If truncate fails, QEMU will get a 0-byte disk with no helpful error.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated build-integration.md: LZ4 status changed from 'Needs verification' to 'resolved' — assets repackaged without --lz4 compression.
Updated architecture.md: Corrected _qemu_input_send_mouse signature from 3 params (dx, dy, buttons) to 4 params (dx, dy, dz, buttons) where dz is scroll wheel delta.

Added QEMU Key Numbers vs PS/2 Scancodes section to architecture.md documenting the 0x80 bit convention for extended keys. This prevents future workers from using raw PS/2 scancodes instead of QEMU key numbers.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the 'Never swallow errors silently' convention with a carve-out for frame-by-frame render loops and browser API calls where failure is expected/benign (e.g., Fullscreen API rejection). Suggest minimum: log to console.debug or count errors for persistent failure detection.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three separate features (display-and-linux-poc, controls-ui, frontend-skeleton) used empty catch blocks. display.ts:193 for render loop resilience, controls.ts:210 for Fullscreen API, emulator.ts for various browser API fallbacks. Each reviewer flagged this as conflicting with AGENTS.md convention.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note under Key Technical Details: 'QEMU key numbers: standard keys use base PS/2 scancodes (0x00-0x7F). Extended keys (arrows, nav, right modifiers) must use scancode | 0x80 (0x80-0xFF). See .factory/library/architecture.md for reference table.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: keyboard-and-mouse-input worker used raw PS/2 scancodes instead of QEMU key numbers for ~15 extended keys. Architecture.md now has the reference but AGENTS.md should point to it to prevent recurrence.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update frontend-worker skill: (1) Add curl-based verification as explicit fallback when Playwright browser deps are unavailable. (2) Relax strict TDD requirement for features that resume partial implementations — allow 'verify existing tests pass + add new tests' instead of red-green-refactor. (3) Correct _qemu_input_send_mouse to 4 params. (4) Clarify that PS/2 scancode mapping should use QEMU key numbers (not raw PS/2 Set 1).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: 3 of 5 workers deviated from browser verification due to missing Playwright deps. templeos-boot worker noted TDD not practical for resumed features. keyboard-and-mouse-input worker noted misleading skill guidance on scancodes and mouse params.

rejectedObservations.observation: build-linux-poc.sh should be registered in services.yaml as a command
rejectedObservations.reason: The Linux PoC build script is a one-time development tool, not a recurring service/command. It downloads Alpine assets for a proof-of-concept that's already been validated and isn't needed for ongoing development. Adding it to services.yaml would add clutter for minimal benefit.

rejectedObservations.observation: environment.md should document missing Playwright system deps
rejectedObservations.reason: Already documented in .factory/library/user-testing.md and docs/playwright-limitations.md (commit b36eddf). Adding to environment.md would be duplicate documentation.

rejectedObservations.observation: Convention needed for DOM element null assertions
rejectedObservations.reason: This is a valid but low-priority concern. The non-null assertion pattern is common in vanilla TypeScript frontend projects where HTML structure is controlled by the same codebase. Adding a helper function is a nice-to-have refinement, not a convention that needs enforcement across workers.
